name: Unbreakable Formation
oracle_text:
Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
Addendum — If you cast this spell during your main phase, put a +1/+1 counter on each of those creatures and they gain vigilance until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: Addendum — If you cast this spell during your main phase, put a +1/+1 counter on each of those creatures and they gain vigilance until end of turn.

needs.what: a condition key that asks whether this spell was cast during its controller's own main phase -- e.g. {"cast_during": "main"} or {"cast_in_phase": ["precombat_main", "postcombat_main"]}. It must read the phase/step recorded at the moment the spell was *put on the stack*, not the phase at resolution, so the engine also has to stamp the casting phase (and the caster-vs-active-player relationship) onto the spell object when it is cast, the way `kicked`, `evoked` and `overloaded` already stamp cast-time choices.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `is_your_turn` is the closest condition in `condition_keys`, but it only compares state.active_player to the source's controller -- it says nothing about the phase, so it would return true for a Formation cast during your own combat or end step, where Addendum must not apply. It is also evaluated at resolution rather than at cast time. `has_flag` reads a flag written by `set_flag` on a permanent's own object and there is no effect that runs at cast time to write one, and `zone_is` reports the source's current zone, not when or where it was cast. No key in `condition_keys` (nor any value in `value_keys`) exposes the turn's phase or step at all.
